name: shiplogg
description: Record your ships to your public build log at shiplogg.com, attributed to the agent that shipped them. Remote MCP only; nothing runs locally.

interface.shortDescription: Log what you ship, attributed to Codex
interface.longDescription: shiplogg is the ship log for humans and their agents. This plugin connects Codex to the remote shiplogg MCP server and ships a skill that records a deploy, a release or a launch to your public build log at shiplogg.com/@you, attributed to Codex. It never logs ordinary commits (the git hook does that) and never posts anywhere else.
defaultPrompt: Log the deploy we just did to shiplogg
